portfolio.empty_ledger_body: Import a broker statement once and every tab fills in: positions, returns, risk, dividends, fees and tax.
portfolio.ledger_no_positions: Ledger has rows but no positions could be built. Check the Import preview.
portfolio.data_unavailable: Market data unavailable right now — switch tabs or reload to retry.
portfolio.prices_unavailable: Prices unavailable right now — reload to retry.
portfolio.unpriced_note: Positions with no live price: {n} of {total} — what you paid and the value today above both leave them out.
portfolio.unlisted_note: No Yahoo symbol for {tickers} — a broker code needs mapping to one (SAN → SAN.MC), so waiting will not price it. Tell us which through Send feedback.
portfolio.empty_positions_body: You have closed every position, so there is nothing to value today. Realised gains and the tax report still include them.
portfolio.cost_basis_help: What you paid for the shares you still hold, fees included, at each buy day's exchange rate.
portfolio.market_value_help: What you would get if you sold everything now, at market prices.
portfolio.unrealised_pl_help: How much your holdings are up today on what you paid for them. It can change until you sell.
portfolio.realised_pl_help: Profit from sales already made (FIFO, at each day's ECB rate). Yours for good, even if reinvested. Breakdown on the Realized & tax tab.
portfolio.market_closed_note: Market closed — the day change shows the last completed session's move (dimmed until the market reopens).
portfolio.premarket_note: Pre-market — the day change is the pre-open move against the previous close.
portfolio.postmarket_note: After hours — the day change includes the post-close move.
portfolio.positions_caption: Live prices via yfinance at the ECB spot rate. Today/week/month use today's holdings at daily closes (fixed basket, not flow-adjusted). n/a = no price/FX.
portfolio.not_enough_history: Not enough data to build the history.
portfolio.hist_note_injected: Contributed = cumulative buys (incl. fees) minus sale proceeds, at transaction-date ECB rates. Value = daily closes × ECB daily FX. Dividends excluded.
portfolio.empty_risk_body: Allocation and risk describe what you hold today, and you hold nothing right now. They appear when you open a position.
portfolio.report_failed: Couldn't build the report — the price & profile download failed. Switch tabs or reload to retry.
portfolio.real_perf_note: Built from your portfolio's daily value: sold positions, dividends and FX included. Deposits and withdrawals don't count as performance.
portfolio.twr_return_help: What your investments returned a year, leaving out your deposits and withdrawals (TWR): compare it with an index. The pill adds your timing (IRR).
portfolio.mwr_help: How much the money you put in returned a year, counting when you put it in (IRR).
portfolio.twr_vol_help: Volatility: how much your actual portfolio swung day to day (deposits and withdrawals left out), scaled to a year. Higher = bumpier.
portfolio.twr_dd_help: Your portfolio's worst fall in %, high to low, leaving out deposits and withdrawals. Every day weighs the same, whatever it was worth.
portfolio.twr_dd_help_span: Worst fall in %, deposits and withdrawals left out: {peak} to {trough}, when the portfolio was worth {value}. Not money lost on what you hold today.
portfolio.twr_var_help: On 19 days in 20 your real portfolio did no worse than this in a day, deposits and withdrawals left out. The 20th day can be worse.
portfolio.basket_vol_help: Volatility: how much today's holdings swung day to day over this period, scaled to a year. Higher = bumpier.
portfolio.basket_dd_help: Worst peak-to-trough fall of today's holdings over this period: a stress test, NOT a loss you took.
portfolio.basket_var_help: On 19 days in 20 today's holdings would have done no worse than this in a day over this period. A stress test, not a loss you took.
portfolio.effective_names_help: Behaves like N equal-sized positions. Higher = more spread out. 10 holdings with 2 very large ≈ 3–4.
portfolio.top5_help: Share of your portfolio's market value held in your 5 largest positions.
portfolio.basket_beta_caption: Market sensitivity: {betas}. At β 1.2, if the index rises 1%, your portfolio moves ≈ 1.2%. Above 1 amplifies; below 1 dampens.
portfolio.alloc_pin_hint: Click or tap to pin the breakdown
portfolio.period_span: {start} to {end} · applies to the cards below
portfolio.real_perf_sub: What your account actually did, with your real buys and sells.
portfolio.basket_risk_sub: A simulation: today's holdings replayed over the past. Not what you earned.
portfolio.alloc_sub: Share of today's market value (not affected by the period), excluding unpriced positions. Tap a slice to see what it's made of.
portfolio.alloc_funds_note: A fund appears in several sectors or countries; each counts only its share.
portfolio.alloc_broker_caption: Broker = where each holding is custodied, from the import note. Split positions are prorated by share count.
portfolio.series_current_basket: If you'd always held today's mix
portfolio.twr_note: Actual (TWR) = time-weighted daily return, flow-adjusted, from your first trade. Today's holdings = your current positions simulated at fixed weights.
portfolio.flow_matched_note: Your line is what you made; the others are what the same buys and sells, on the same days, would have made in each index.
portfolio.twr_note_skipped: Days excluded from the return: {days} — the cash moved but the value path didn't follow (an unrecorded split or corporate action).
portfolio.corr_how: Each square: how much two holdings move together, −1 to +1. Red = together, grey = on their own, blue = opposite. Use arrow keys, hover or tap.
portfolio.corr_avg_help: How alike your holdings are, −1 to 1, bigger ones counting more. Near 0 they offset; above 0.5 they tend to fall together.
portfolio.corr_top_pair_help: The two heaviest holdings that move in step. If they fall, they fall together: for risk they count almost as one.
portfolio.corr_diversifier_help: The position least like the rest of the book: its weighted average correlation with the others is the lowest.
portfolio.corr_risk_top_help: The holding most of the book's ups and downs come from. If it adds more than it weighs, it carries more risk than its size.
portfolio.corr_beta_help: How much the book moves when the index moves: at 1.20, a 1% move in the index tends to be 1.2% in the book, up and down.
portfolio.corr_story_very_high: {a} and {b} move almost as one: when one falls, the other usually does too. They diversify each other very little.
portfolio.corr_story_high: {a} and {b} tend to move the same way. They share much of their risk.
portfolio.corr_story_moderate: {a} and {b} share some movement, but each largely goes its own way.
portfolio.corr_story_low: {a} and {b} move almost independently: a good pair for diversification.
portfolio.corr_story_negative: {a} and {b} tend to move opposite: one cushions the other's falls.
portfolio.corr_no_overlap: Not enough days in common to measure this pair.
portfolio.corr_risk_more: It adds more risk than it weighs: it moves a lot or moves with the rest.
portfolio.corr_risk_less: It adds less risk than it weighs: it helps diversify.
portfolio.corr_risk_even: Its risk is in line with its weight.
portfolio.corr_risk_hedge: It lowers the book's risk: it acts as a hedge.
portfolio.corr_basis: Daily returns in {base}, {window}. Only today's holdings with 30 or more shared days.
portfolio.corr_verdict: Your holdings move {how}: average correlation {value}. Most linked: {pair}.
portfolio.corr_single: One holding: nothing to compare it with.
portfolio.empty_realized_body: A gain or loss is realised, and taxable, only when you sell. Until then, see your unsold gain on the Positions tab.
portfolio.all_years_caption: Each tax year is netted and taxed on its own, so this is the sum of every year's closed figures, not one taxable base. Pick a year for its rules.
portfolio.es_tax_caption: IRPF: gains and dividends go in the *savings base*, taxed at 19–30%. FIFO: sales match your oldest shares first (art. 37 LIRPF).
portfolio.es_net_taxable_help: Gains minus deductible losses for the year plus gross dividends, in EUR at each date's ECB rate. A net loss offsets only 25% of the dividends.
portfolio.es_estimated_tax_help: Savings-base brackets applied to the net taxable amount — ignores your other income and regional quirks.
portfolio.es_carryforward_loss_help: Net loss you can offset against gains in the next 4 years.
portfolio.es_cross_offset_note: · a net loss offsets only 25% of the dividends (€{offset})
portfolio.es_realized_by_year_caption: Gains and dividends stack up, deductible losses (and recovered deferrals) stack down; the diamond is the net savings base that gets taxed.
portfolio.es_realized_by_month_caption: Monthly view: a breakdown of when the result was booked. IRPF nets the savings base over the whole fiscal year, not month by month.
portfolio.tip_pick_year: Click to see this year below
portfolio.tip_pick_month: Click to see this month's sales below
portfolio.tax_download_hint: The CSV lists the year's sales lot by lot and the dividends gross and withheld, in {currency}, for your return.
portfolio.es_tax_download_hint: CSV for Modelo 100: sales lot by lot (listed shares) and dividends gross and withheld (box 0029), in EUR.
portfolio.es_flag_modelo_720: Modelo 720 (informative declaration of assets held abroad, 50.000 EUR line): {message}
portfolio.es_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — verify with your gestor / Renta.
portfolio.empty_dividends_body: Dividend rows come from the imported statement, so a payment it omits won't show. Import one with dividends, or hold a payer, and this tab also estimates your earnings.
portfolio.dividends_caption: Creditable = Spanish double-tax credit (capped at 15%). Withholding shows 0 unless you edited dividend fees; Revolut's CSV doesn't break it out.
portfolio.div_kpi_total_help: Every dividend your ledger booked, at its own date's rate. The chip is what your shares were entitled to over the same span.
portfolio.div_kpi_ytd_help: Booked so far this calendar year. The chip is the estimate for the same year; a December ex-date paid in January counts next year.
portfolio.div_kpi_next_help: The next 12 months on today's shares, at what each company paid over the last 12 months. Gross, and only if you sell nothing.
portfolio.div_hero_sub: With today's shares, at the pace each company paid over the last year — gross.
portfolio.div_est_only: Your ledger holds no dividend rows, so everything below is estimated from the shares you held — nothing here is a receipt.
portfolio.div_monthly_help: The same estimate spread over 12 months — dividends actually arrive in lumps, mostly quarterly.
portfolio.div_yield_on_cost_help: Estimated annual income over what you paid for your open positions, commissions included.
portfolio.div_forward_caption: Assumes you hold today's shares for a year and each company repeats last year's payments. Per-share amounts in the company's currency; totals at today's rate.
portfolio.div_history_title: What your shares were entitled to
portfolio.div_unrecorded_hint: About {val} more than your ledger booked: partly tax withheld at source (Revolut reports net), partly payments the import missed. Check before using it for tax.
portfolio.div_history_caption: Estimated from each company's dividend history and your shares the day before each ex-date, gross at the ex-date rate. Never feeds the tax figures.
portfolio.es_flag_modelo_720_reportable: foreign holdings ~{val} ≥ {threshold}: Modelo 720 may apply if held via a non-Spanish broker.
portfolio.empty_fees_body: See what each trade really cost: the commission plus the spread you paid against that day's mid price. Import buys and sells and it fills in.
portfolio.fees_explicit_help: Trade commissions from the ledger plus standalone charges (custody, account), converted at the rate for each row's own date.
portfolio.fees_spread_help: Cost vs the session midpoint ((high+low)/2): buys above mid and sells below cost money. Over the book, it is the broker's spread. Can be negative.
portfolio.fees_pct_volume_help: Fees plus estimated spread, as a % of executed volume (buys + sells).
portfolio.fees_hero_sub: {pct} of {volume} traded — commissions plus estimated spread
portfolio.fees_hero_sub_unmeasured: On {volume} traded — spread excluded, it could not be measured
portfolio.fees_spread_coverage: Spread estimated on {measured} of {total} trades — the rest have no daily bar on their date (holiday or symbol without history).
portfolio.fees_outside_range: Of that, {val} comes from executions outside the day's high–low range — definitely broker markup, not intraday noise.
portfolio.fees_caption: Broker = source of each import. Revolut's CSV breaks out no commissions or FX markup; its costs show as spread. bps = basis points (0.01%). Dividend withholding is in Dividends.
portfolio.tax_caption: Realized gains and losses for the year, lots matched FIFO (oldest first).
portfolio.tax_unmodelled: Your browser says **{region}**, which isn't modelled yet: this tab shows **{label}** rules applied to your book, almost certainly not what you owe. Pick your residence in Profile.
portfolio.us_tax_caption: US federal capital gains. Lots held over a year are long-term (0/15/20%), the rest short-term at ordinary rates. FIFO. A loss is disallowed if you rebuy within 30 days.
portfolio.net_taxable_help: Realized gains minus deductible losses for the year, converted at each transaction date's official rate.
portfolio.us_net_taxable_help: Net capital gain after the short- and long-term buckets net against each other — USD at each transaction date's rate.
portfolio.estimated_tax_help: Your jurisdiction's brackets applied to the net taxable amount.
portfolio.us_estimated_tax_help: Federal only: ordinary rates on short-term gain, 0/15/20% on long-term, plus NIIT if on. No state tax or AMT.
portfolio.carryforward_loss_help: Net loss you can offset against later gains.
portfolio.us_carryforward_loss_help: Net loss left after the $3,000 deduction ($1,500 filing separately); carries forward indefinitely, keeping its short/long character.
portfolio.short_net_help: Gains less deductible losses on lots held a year or less — taxed at ordinary income rates.
portfolio.long_net_help: Gains less deductible losses on lots held more than a year — taxed at the preferential 0/15/20% rates.
portfolio.us_bracket_year_note: · rates are the {year} tables — later years aren't published here yet
portfolio.realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, deductible losses (and restored losses) stack down; the diamond is the net that gets taxed.
portfolio.us_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, deductible losses (and losses restored when replacement shares were sold) stack down; the diamond is the net capital gain.
portfolio.realized_by_month_caption: Monthly view: a breakdown of when the result was booked. Tax is settled over the whole year, not month by month.
portfolio.us_realized_by_month_caption: Monthly view: a breakdown of when the result was booked. The short- and long-term buckets net over the whole tax year, not month by month.
portfolio.flag_default_reportable: holdings abroad ~{val} ≥ {threshold} — a reporting duty may apply.
portfolio.us_flag_fbar_reportable: holdings abroad ~{val} ≥ {threshold}: FBAR may apply if they sit in a foreign account — not if your broker is a US one.
portfolio.us_flag_form_8938_reportable: holdings abroad ~{val} ≥ {threshold}: Form 8938 may apply — foreign stock held in a US brokerage account is outside it.
portfolio.planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — check it before you file.
portfolio.us_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — federal only, no state tax, and FIFO rather than any lot election. Check it with your CPA before filing.
portfolio.de_tax_caption: German Abgeltungsteuer: flat 25% plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge (26.375%), church tax on top if you pay it. FIFO, no wash-sale rule. Share losses only offset share gains.
portfolio.de_net_taxable_help: Capital income after the two loss circles net and the Sparer-Pauschbetrag comes off (€1,000, €2,000 filing jointly).
portfolio.de_estimated_tax_help: 25% Abgeltungsteuer plus 5.5% solidarity surcharge, plus church tax at your Profile rate. Ignores the Günstigerprüfung.
portfolio.de_carryforward_loss_help: Unused losses, carried forward indefinitely. Share and general pools carry separately: a share loss never offsets fund income.
portfolio.de_share_net_help: Gains less losses on individual shares (§20(6) EStG). A net loss waits for a future share gain; it can't touch fund or interest income.
portfolio.de_general_net_help: Funds, certificates and everything else, after the 30% partial exemption. A net loss here does offset share gains.
portfolio.de_funds_unclassified_note: · no fund classification yet, so the 30% Teilfreistellung is not applied — open the Ticker page for your funds once and it is learned
portfolio.de_share_loss_note: · €{carry} of share losses carried forward, deductible only against share gains
portfolio.de_church_note: · includes church tax at {rate}% of the tax
portfolio.de_vorabpauschale_note: · the Vorabpauschale on accumulating funds is not modelled (it needs each fund's year-end NAV and the Basiszins)
portfolio.de_flag_anlage_kap_reportable: holdings abroad ~{val} — a foreign broker withholds no Abgeltungsteuer, so this income has to be declared (KAP-INV for funds).
portfolio.de_flag_anlage_kap_ok: nothing held abroad — a German broker withholds at source.
portfolio.de_flag_awv_reportable: foreign securities ~{val} ≥ {threshold}: monthly statistical reporting to the Bundesbank may apply.
portfolio.de_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — no Vorabpauschale, no Günstigerprüfung, no church-tax edge cases. Check it with your Steuerberater before filing.
portfolio.de_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, deductible losses stack down; the diamond is the capital income the flat rate taxes, before the Sparer-Pauschbetrag.
portfolio.de_realized_by_month_caption: Monthly view: a breakdown of when the result was booked. The loss circles and the allowance settle over the whole year, not month by month.
portfolio.uk_tax_caption: UK CGT on shares: 18% in your remaining basic-rate band, 24% above, after the £3,000 allowance. Tax year 6 April–5 April. Cost uses Section 104 pooling.
portfolio.uk_net_taxable_help: Gains less this year's losses and the Annual Exempt Amount. Losses come off first, so a loss year can waste the allowance.
portfolio.uk_estimated_tax_help: 18% on the gain inside your remaining basic-rate band, 24% above, using other income from Profile. Rates from 30 October 2024.
portfolio.uk_allowance_help: Annual Exempt Amount actually used this year (£3,000 for 2024/25 and 2025/26). It cannot be carried forward — unused, it is simply gone.
portfolio.uk_carryforward_loss_help: Net loss to carry forward indefinitely once claimed to HMRC. It only reduces later gains down to the allowance, which this figure doesn't apply.
portfolio.uk_wasted_allowance_note: · £{wasted} of the allowance wasted (losses come off first)
portfolio.uk_proceeds_test_note: · disposal proceeds £{proceeds} exceed £50,000, so a return is due even with no gain
portfolio.uk_carryforward_note: · claim the loss with HMRC to carry it forward — an unclaimed loss expires after four years
portfolio.uk_straddle_note: · 2024/25 straddled the 30 October 2024 rate change; the whole year is priced at the post-Budget 18/24%
portfolio.uk_rate_year_note: · rates and allowance are the {year}/26 figures — later years aren't published here yet
portfolio.uk_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — no ISA or SIPP wrappers, no personal-allowance taper, no relief claims. Check it before you file.
portfolio.uk_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, losses stack down; the diamond is the net gain the allowance then comes off. Years run 6 April to 5 April.
portfolio.uk_realized_by_month_caption: Monthly view: a breakdown of when the result was booked. Losses and the allowance settle over the whole tax year, not month by month.
portfolio.fr_tax_caption: French PFU: flat 30% on the net gain (12.8% income tax + 17.2% social charges). Average-cost basis, no allowance. Losses carry forward 10 years, same nature only.
portfolio.fr_net_taxable_help: Net gain for the calendar year, in EUR at each trade date's ECB rate. A negative result is a moins-value that carries forward.
portfolio.fr_estimated_tax_help: The 30% PFU on the net gain. Ignores the option for the barème progressif, the CEHR on high incomes, and anything inside a PEA.
portfolio.fr_carryforward_loss_help: Moins-value to carry forward — 10 years, and only against plus-values of the same nature.
portfolio.fr_income_tax_help: The impôt sur le revenu half of the PFU, the part that goes on the 2042-C.
portfolio.fr_social_charges_help: CSG 9.2%, CRDS 0.5% and prélèvement de solidarité 7.5%, on the same net gain.
portfolio.fr_cehr_note: · a result this size can push your revenu fiscal de référence past €250,000, where the CEHR adds 3–4% — not included here
portfolio.fr_pea_note: · a PEA sits outside all of this: nothing inside one is taxed until you take money out
portfolio.fr_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, losses stack down; the diamond is the net plus-value the 30% PFU taxes.
portfolio.fr_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — no barème option, no CEHR, no PEA. Check it before you file.
portfolio.fr_flag_formulaire_3916_report: securities abroad ~{val}: a foreign account is declarable whatever it holds, and the gains go on the 2074.
portfolio.fr_flag_formulaire_3916_ok: nothing held abroad — your broker's IFU covers the declaration.
portfolio.it_tax_caption: Italian imposta sostitutiva: flat 26% on the year's saldo. LIFO matching (art. 67 TUIR). Losses carry forward four years, then expire.
portfolio.it_net_taxable_help: Saldo between plusvalenze and minusvalenze for the calendar year, in EUR at each transaction date's ECB rate.
portfolio.it_estimated_tax_help: 26% on a positive saldo. In regime amministrato your broker withholds it for you; this is the regime dichiarativo view, the one that goes in quadro RT.
portfolio.it_carryforward_loss_help: Minusvalenza to carry forward — four years, against plusvalenze only. Unused by then, it is gone.
portfolio.it_lifo_note: · LIFO: the shares sold are the most recently bought ones
portfolio.it_carryforward_note: · €{carry} carried forward, expires after four years
portfolio.it_regime_note: · in regime amministrato the broker withholds and nets your losses for you; nothing then reaches quadro RT
portfolio.it_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, losses stack down; the diamond is the saldo the 26% substitute tax applies to.
portfolio.it_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — no imposta di bollo, no qualified-holding rules, no white-list bond rate. Check it with your commercialista.
portfolio.it_flag_quadro_rw_reportable: securities abroad ~{val}: quadro RW applies at any value, and IVAFE takes 0.2% of it a year on top of the tax on gains.
portfolio.it_flag_quadro_rw_ok: nothing held abroad — no quadro RW, no IVAFE.
portfolio.ie_tax_caption: Irish CGT: 33% on the net gain after the €1,270 exemption, FIFO. A loss on shares rebought within four weeks is restricted. Irish/EU funds: 41% exit tax instead.
portfolio.ie_net_taxable_help: What the two rates are applied to: the chargeable gain after losses and the exemption, plus any fund gain.
portfolio.ie_estimated_tax_help: 33% CGT on share gains plus 41% exit tax on gains classed as funds. This can't tell fund domiciles apart (a US ETF is CGT).
portfolio.ie_carryforward_loss_help: Unused share losses, carried forward indefinitely. Fund losses are not allowable, so they are excluded.
portfolio.ie_exemption_help: The €1,270 annual personal exemption actually used. It cannot be carried forward, and it cannot be transferred to a spouse.
portfolio.ie_fund_net_help: Gains and losses on holdings classified as funds. Only a positive result is taxed — at 41% — and a negative one relieves nothing at all.
portfolio.ie_wasted_exemption_note: · €{wasted} of the exemption wasted — losses come off before it
portfolio.ie_four_week_note: · €{deferred} restricted by the four-week rule until the reacquired shares are sold
portfolio.ie_fund_note: · €{gain} of fund gains at the 41% exit tax, outside the exemption
portfolio.ie_fund_loss_note: · €{loss} of fund losses relieve nothing — the gross roll-up regime gives no relief for them
portfolio.ie_funds_unclassified_note: · no fund classification yet, so everything is treated as shares at 33% — open the Ticker page for your ETFs once and it is learned
portfolio.ie_carryforward_note: · losses carry forward indefinitely, against chargeable gains only
portfolio.ie_payment_note: · CGT on disposals from 1 January to 30 November is payable by 15 December of the same year
portfolio.ie_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, allowable losses stack down; the diamond is what the 33% and 41% rates are applied to.
portfolio.ie_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — no eight-year deemed disposal, no fund domicile check, no development-land rules. Check it before you file.
portfolio.pt_tax_caption: Portuguese IRS: 28% on the year's saldo, FIFO, no allowance. Gains held under 365 days may be aggregated with other income. Losses carry forward 5 years if you opt for englobamento.
portfolio.pt_net_taxable_help: The saldo for the calendar year — gains less losses across both holding periods, in EUR at each transaction date's rate.
portfolio.pt_estimated_tax_help: 28% on the saldo, or 48% on gains held under 365 days when your income reaches the top bracket. Excludes the solidarity surcharge.
portfolio.pt_carryforward_loss_help: Negative saldo, carried five years — and only if you opt for englobamento in the year of the loss.
portfolio.pt_short_net_help: Net result on securities held less than a year. This is the part a top-bracket filer has to aggregate at the marginal rate.
portfolio.pt_long_net_help: Net result on securities held a year or longer — always the flat 28%.
portfolio.pt_flat_rate_note: · flat 28% on the saldo, no allowance
portfolio.pt_aggregation_note: · €{short} from holdings under 365 days must be englobado at your marginal rate — your taxable income reaches the top bracket
portfolio.pt_solidarity_note: · the solidarity surcharge (2.5% above €80,000, 5% above €250,000) is not included
portfolio.pt_short_term_note: · €{short} came from holdings under 365 days: taxed at 28% here, but englobamento becomes mandatory once your taxable income reaches €{threshold}
portfolio.pt_carryforward_note: · carrying the loss five years requires opting for englobamento in the year of the loss
portfolio.pt_bracket_year_note: · the top-bracket threshold is the {year} figure — later years aren't published here yet
portfolio.pt_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, losses stack down; the diamond is the saldo the 28% rate applies to.
portfolio.pt_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — no solidarity surcharge, no NHR regime, and the AT wants its own exchange rates rather than the ECB's. Check it before you file.
portfolio.pt_flag_anexo_j_reportable: securities abroad ~{val}: gains at a foreign broker go in anexo J operation by operation — no Portuguese broker files it for you.
portfolio.pt_flag_anexo_j_ok: nothing held abroad — anexo G alone covers the disposals.
portfolio.ca_tax_caption: Canadian capital gains: half the net gain is taxable at your marginal rate (federal plus the province set in Profile). Average cost (ACB). A loss on a 30-day rebuy joins the new ACB.
portfolio.ca_net_taxable_help: Net capital gain for the calendar year, in CAD at each trade date's rate. Half of it reaches your return.
portfolio.ca_estimated_tax_help: Marginal federal tax on the taxable half, stacked on your Profile income, plus the flat provincial rate you set. No AMT or surtaxes.
portfolio.ca_carryforward_loss_help: Net capital loss, carried forward indefinitely — against capital gains only, never against salary.
portfolio.ca_taxable_gain_help: The 50% of the net gain that goes on line 12700 and is taxed as income. The other half is never taxed.
portfolio.ca_inclusion_note: · half the gain is taxable — the 2024 two-thirds proposal was cancelled
portfolio.ca_superficial_loss_note: · {denied} denied as a superficial loss — it moves into the replacement shares' ACB
portfolio.ca_no_provincial_note: · federal only — set your provincial rate in Profile, it is roughly half the bill
portfolio.ca_carryback_note: · a net capital loss can also be carried back three years (T1A), which this does not apply for you
portfolio.ca_bracket_year_note: · rates are the {year} federal brackets — later years aren't published here yet
portfolio.ca_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, allowable losses stack down; the diamond is the net capital gain, half of which is taxed.
portfolio.ca_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — federal brackets plus one flat provincial rate, no AMT, nothing about RRSPs or TFSAs. Check it with your accountant.
portfolio.ca_flag_t1135_reportable: foreign property ~{val} at market ≥ {threshold}: T1135 may apply — the real test is total cost, and a foreign share held in a Canadian account still counts.
portfolio.ca_flag_t1135_ok: foreign property ~{val} at market < {threshold} — the test is cost, so check it if you are near the line.
portfolio.au_tax_caption: Australian CGT: net gain is ordinary income at your marginal rate plus 2% Medicare levy. Assets held over 12 months get a 50% discount. Income year 1 July–30 June.
portfolio.au_net_taxable_help: Net capital gain after this year's losses and the 50% discount, in AUD at each trade date's rate. This joins your taxable income.
portfolio.au_estimated_tax_help: Marginal tax on the net capital gain, stacked on your Profile income, plus the 2% Medicare levy. No levy surcharge or offsets.
portfolio.au_carryforward_loss_help: Unapplied capital losses, carried forward indefinitely — against capital gains only, never against salary.
portfolio.au_discount_help: What the 50% CGT discount takes off gains on assets held more than 12 months. Selling one day early loses all of it.
portfolio.au_loss_order_note: · losses applied to the non-discounted gains first, which is the better order for you
portfolio.au_medicare_note: · includes the 2% Medicare levy, without its low-income shading
portfolio.au_carryforward_note: · losses carry forward indefinitely, against capital gains only
portfolio.au_rate_year_note: · rates are the {year}-26 scale — later years aren't published here yet
portfolio.au_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, losses stack down; the diamond is the net capital gain after the discount. Income years run 1 July to 30 June.
portfolio.au_realized_by_month_caption: Monthly view: a breakdown of when the result was booked. Losses and the discount settle over the whole income year, not month by month.
portfolio.au_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice — FIFO rather than parcel selection, no levy surcharge, nothing about super. Check it with your tax agent.
portfolio.ae_tax_caption: The UAE taxes none of this: no personal income or capital gains tax on an individual. This tab is a record of what you made, not a bill. Figures in AED (3.6725 peg).
portfolio.ae_net_taxable_help: Realized gains minus realized losses for the calendar year, in AED. Shown so you can see the number — nothing is assessed on it.
portfolio.ae_estimated_tax_help: Zero, and not by a threshold or an allowance you could exceed: the UAE has no personal income tax for a capital gain to fall under.
portfolio.ae_no_tax_note: · no personal tax on this — 0% on capital gains, at any amount
portfolio.ae_no_carryforward_note: · a losing year carries nothing forward: a carryforward offsets future tax, and there is none
portfolio.ae_corporate_note: · corporate tax (9% above AED 375,000) reaches a portfolio run through a licensed entity, not personal investment held in your own name
portfolio.ae_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, losses stack down; the diamond is the year's net result. None of it is taxed here — the shape is for you, not for a return.
portfolio.ae_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice. Assumes you hold personally and are UAE tax resident all year; a previous residence may still tax the year you left.
portfolio.ae_flag_no_local_reporting_ok: ~{val} abroad — the UAE asks residents to declare nothing. Your broker's country may still report the account under CRS, and a previous tax residence may still want a return.
portfolio.ch_tax_caption: Switzerland does not tax a private investor's capital gains (art. 16 para. 3 DBG), at any amount or holding period. This tab is a record. Figures in CHF at the ECB rate.
portfolio.ch_net_taxable_help: Realized gains minus realized losses for the calendar year, in CHF. Shown so you can see the number — nothing is assessed on it.
portfolio.ch_estimated_tax_help: Zero, as long as you are a private investor and not a professional securities dealer. That distinction is the only thing standing between this number and your marginal rate.
portfolio.ch_exempt_note: · private capital gains are exempt (art. 16 para. 3 DBG) — 0%, at any amount
portfolio.ch_dealer_note: · the exemption holds within KS 36: held 6+ months, turnover under 5× the portfolio, gains under half your income, no debt, no speculative derivatives
portfolio.ch_no_relief_note: · a losing year relieves nothing: where the gain is exempt, the loss is not deductible against anything, ever
portfolio.ch_wealth_note: · the gain is exempt, but year-end value feeds the cantonal wealth tax and dividends are income; neither is in the figures above
portfolio.ch_realized_by_year_caption: Gains stack up, losses stack down; the diamond is the year's net. None of it is taxed for a private investor.
portfolio.ch_planning_aid: Planning aid, not tax advice. Assumes private holding, not professional dealing. Leaves out cantonal wealth tax, dividend tax and 35% Verrechnungssteuer. Check with your Treuhänder.
portfolio.ch_flag_wertschriftenverzeichn: securities ~{val}: each holding goes in the securities schedule at its 31 December value. The gain is exempt; the value feeds cantonal wealth tax.
nothing held: an empty securities schedule is still part of the return.
portfolio.demo_offer_caption: Not ready to import? Fill this page with a demo book — seven well-known stocks, real prices, made up trades.
portfolio.demo_seeded_toast: Demo transactions added — every tab is filled with them.
portfolio.demo_banner: These are demo transactions, not yours. Your first import or typed trade removes them.
portfolio.guest_demo_banner: These are demo transactions on a shared example account, not yours — real prices, invented trades. Sign in to import your own statement and see your real portfolio here.
portfolio.zoom_hint: Drag across the chart to zoom into those days; double-click to reset.
portfolio.span_hint: Right-click two dates, or use two fingers on a phone, to see what changed between them.
portfolio.overview_injected_help: What you put in from your own pocket, less what you took out — money collected from a sale counts as taken out.
portfolio.overview_annualised_help: Yearly return on the money you put in, counting when you put it in (IRR). Your picks, ignoring timing (TWR): {twr}.
portfolio.overview_young_help: What your money has made since you started, counting when you put it in (IRR). Under a year in, so not annualised. Your picks (TWR): {twr}.
portfolio.overview_tax_help: What this year's realized sales would owe under your tax jurisdiction, in its currency. Detail in Realized & tax.
portfolio.overview_fees_help: Commissions and fees your brokers charged this year. The spread estimate is in the Fees tab.
portfolio.overview_monthly_first_year: Until {date}, when your book turns one, lines show return since your first trade, not annualised (a few months stretched to a year exaggerate). After that they are annual rates.
portfolio.overview_monthly_young: Your book is under a year old, so lines show return since your first trade, not annualised (a few months stretched to a year exaggerate). They turn annual at one year.
portfolio.overview_bridge_contributed_he: What you bought less what you sold in the window. The ledger only sees trades, so a sale counts as money out even if the cash stays at the broker.
portfolio.overview_bridge_gain_help: What your money earned in the window: today's value less what it opened with and what was contributed. The tiles add up to the cent.
portfolio.overview_timing_note: at a steady pace you would have {amount}
portfolio.overview_timing_help: What the dates of your buys and sales added or cost: today's value less what the same money would be worth had it grown at your picks' steady pace.
portfolio.overview_monthly_note: The window crops the chart; lines are always since your first trade. Each bar is that month's own time-weighted return, not annualised. Tiles above are the window's euros.
portfolio.missing_prices: {n} holdings without prices: valued at cost, left out of the return
portfolio.missing_prices_one: 1 holding without prices: valued at cost, left out of the return
portfolio.missing_prices_list: Without price history, valued at cost: {tickers}
portfolio.projection_range_help: 8 in 10 scenarios end inside this range; 1 in 10 below it and 1 in 10 above.
portfolio.projection_note: Not a prediction: 4,000 simulated scenarios from today's value. Index references approximate long-run nominal returns with dividends. Contributions added monthly. No taxes or fees.
portfolio.projection_empty_body: Import your trades or set a monthly contribution to see the range of future value.
portfolio.projection_note_own: “Your stocks” and “Your crypto” repeat the compound growth of your current holdings over the same window (up to 2 years): a good stretch projected years ahead is a hypothesis, not a plan.
portfolio.projection_crypto: Crypto ({weight} of the book): annual growth
portfolio.projection_target_help: Share of the simulated scenarios that end the horizon at or above the target.
portfolio.projection_note_stocks: Stocks ({weight} today): median growth of {rate} a year, volatility {vol} (your current stocks', last 2 years).
portfolio.projection_note_crypto: Crypto ({weight}): {rate} a year, volatility {vol}; correlation with stocks {corr}.
portfolio.projection_note_real: Future in today's money ({rate} a year inflation); the past in the money of its day.
portfolio.heat_summary: Correlation between holdings. Moves most together: {high}. Most apart: {low}.
portfolio.attr_sub: The window's change in value, split into what you put in and what the market, the currency and income did.
portfolio.attr_empty: Nothing to explain yet: no priced history in this window.
portfolio.attr_contributions_help: Buys minus sales: money you moved in or out
portfolio.attr_fx_help: Exchange-rate move against your base currency
portfolio.attr_other_help: Not placed above, e.g. a name held at cost
portfolio.attr_note: Bars add up to the end value. Dividends are counted once, taken out of prices. Names without a price history stay at cost.
